heroHeadline: Erdoğan: Turkey Will Not Abandon Syria or Let Israel Set Red Lines in Region
heroSubtitle: Ousted CHP leader Özgür Özel mobilized tens of thousands in a march to Anıtkabir (Atatürk's mausoleum) in Ankara on May 30 — the largest opposition demonstration in Turkey in over a decade — after riot police used water cannons against supporters in İzmir on May 26. The Socialist International unanimously endorsed Özel as the legitimate CHP leader. Court-installed interim chair Kılıçdaroğlu vowed a congress 'as soon as possible' (May 31) without setting a date, while rival events in Ankara cemented the perception of a divided party. Istanbul Mayor İmamoğlu remains jailed with his espionage trial adjourned to July 6. The BIST-100 remains down ~6% from pre-crisis levels as state banks spent $6–8B defending the lira; the July 2026 NATO Summit in Ankara looms as Turkey's next major diplomatic test.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (AP, Reuters, BBC, Washington Post, Euronews, Foreign Policy, Balkan Insight, Turkish Minute, Türkiye Today), Socialist International statements, and US State Department readouts.
